description: core §7.7's "The reader's fields": one key's frames, read in the order they arrive, by one reader that held nothing before the first. Written by an independent reading of the text (Python, standard library), checked, never blessed. Each case names a layout of `layouts.json`. Each frame is its envelope's `run` (as a descriptor spells it: 4 or 8 lowercase hex digits, so a 16-bit and a 32-bit run are two runs) and `seq` (record 0's), its body (`hex`, under the layout's tag) and that body's value (`bodies.json`'s spelling) → `expect`, the frame as the reader reads it: `run`, `seq`, `follows` (`first`: the reader held no run; `continues`: the seq after the last record it read, in the run it holds; `gap`, with `lost`, the records lost: a newer seq by core §4.3's serial order; `rewind`: any other seq of that run, one exactly 2^23 ahead included; `run`: another run), then each record's `seq` (record 0's plus its index, modulo 2^24), `time` (`measured`, `scheduled` or, for record 0 of a frame whose time is unknown, `unknown`), `after_ms` (record 1 on: its offset, or `step_ms` × its index when scheduled), `jitter_ms` (scheduled only), `at` (`{s, ms}` from the deployment epoch, record 0's time plus `after_ms`; none when that time is unknown) and `fields`, every field of the type by name: `{state: known, value}`, `{state: within, value, delta}` (the last value included, and the deadband's delta in its shortest form), `{state: absent}` or `{state: unknown, why}`. `why` names the case of the text's table: `first`, `run`, `gap` or `rewind` (every field turned unknown there and not included since), `deadband` (max_records records after its inclusion), `no_value` (omitted under a deadband after an inclusion that was absent or a reserved code). A field omitted with no deadband holds what it held in the record before, absent included: an owner includes it whenever its code or presence differs. Values are §7.6's JSON reading.

cases.note: a keyframe read first: every field known
a keyframe then a delta frame: the queue and the wait included, the others carried
a delta frame lost: the next one's omitted fields unknown, its included one known, healed by the keyframe after it
absent fields: a keyframe with two absent, a delta that omits them, then one included absent
a late joiner: its first frame a delta, the omitted fields unknown until a full record
another run: every field unknown, then the frame read
a run's width is part of it: 0001 and 00000001 are two runs
a rewind: the seq read again, then an older one
serial order: a key's seq wraps from 2^24 - 1 to 0, and continues
serial order: 2^23 - 1 records lost is a gap, 2^23 ahead is unordered, so a rewind
the owner's clock unknown: its records' fields read as ever, their time unknown
a deadband: queue_depth within 4 for four records after its inclusion, unknown at the fifth
a deadband: an inclusion restarts its count
a deadband: an inclusion that was no value, a reserved code or absent, gives no within
a deadband: a gap ends the within, whatever the count
three records a frame: scheduled within its jitter, and a late record with its offset
three records a frame: a frame lost, three seqs, the next's omitted fields unknown
three records a frame, no jitter: a scheduled record is exactly on its instant, its jitter 0; the owner's clock unknown, its records' offsets still read
a record's seq wraps inside a frame
